Delivery Date.notes: No required delivery date or window is stated. The RFP only asks vendors how quickly shipping could occur after receiving a Purchase Order, and says weeks or months may pass between award and a Purchase Order. Installation.value: Yes. All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services (asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, delivery to varied locations). Vendors must also describe software installation, asset tagging and etching, device deployment and setup, and asset control reporting. Desktops are not to be secured.

Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is seeking Student and Staff Computing Devices under bid JA-207652, including Chromebooks, Windows laptops, tablets, staff laptops and desktops, and monitors in quantities up to 50,000 units per line, plus warranty, deployment and services. Responses are due 2024-07-09 14:00 CST, with electronic submission preferred via the Dallas ISD iSupplier portal or one sealed hard copy to Procurement Services; fax and email are not accepted. A pre-proposal meeting is set for 2024-06-10 14:00 CST via TEAMS and is highly encouraged but not mandatory. The term is three years with two one-year extensions (five years maximum), and quote requests are expected to begin in September 2024. Key requirements include OEM warranties (3-year minimum on Windows laptops), white glove delivery with etching and asset tagging, Autopilot or Google enrollment, and documents such as the W9, MWBE forms, Form 1295, three references, and signed Addendum No. 2 acknowledgement. Bid bond requirement, payment terms, and model and part numbers were not found; the contact is Jasmine Alzate at (972)925-4100 or JALZATE@dallasisd.org.
